Twitter Thread Splitter

Split long text into numbered 280-character tweets with per-tweet copy.

Twitter Thread Splitter

Split long text into numbered tweets of 280 characters or fewer.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your long text into the box.
  2. Click "Split into tweets".
  3. Review the numbered tweets — each is 280 characters or fewer.
  4. Copy tweets individually or all at once, separated by blank lines.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the text split?

Text is split greedily at word boundaries, and every tweet stays within 280 characters including its " (i/n)" counter suffix.

What if adding numbers pushes a tweet over 280?

The numbering reserves space first (e.g. " (12/12)"), so the final tweet never overflows. If the total grows during splitting, the split is recomputed.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. Splitting runs entirely in your browser; your text never leaves your device.
